metadata.title: Green Sand NIR Detection-Limit Benchmark and Leaderboard v1.0.0
metadata.description: Twelve benchmark sets (dry and moist sand; ideal, lab and plant-floor noise; seacoal and red iron oxide) of simulated 1000-2350 nm InGaAs readings, a scoring rule (5% false alarms, 95% detection), baseline results for PCA-LDA, PLSR, SVM, random forest and gradient boosting, and a submission script.
